verdict.rationale: New Relic's core platform is closed-source SaaS, but some peripheral tooling (e.g., the newrelic-cli) is published on GitHub, and community commentary confirms agents are open while the server platform is not (new-relic-comm-11). This only satisfies a narrow slice of the story. Missing for 10: no evidence of an open license for the core product/backend, no repository for the main platform, no license file details for the CLI/agents.
